title: The Midnight Ledger
shortDescription: An empty crate, a disputed clock, and a signature that proves too little.
description: A brass astrolabe disappears from its transit crate before the midnight weigh-in. The porter’s chalk mark is still on the crate, and the assessor has put his name in the shift register. Compare the weight records, work out who had access and when, and bring your findings to the hearing. An original historical detective adventure with recoverable mistakes.
author: Studio Null
